title: Two-level (L1+L2) tiling per-level misses (real C++)
info: L1/L2 miss counts come from two real set-associative LRU cache models in main.cpp (8 sets/2 ways and 64 sets/8 ways, both 64-byte lines), never hardware performance counters
leading dimensions (65) are deliberately not a multiple of either level's set-count*line-size, isolating the tiling lesson from leading-dimension aliasing
C's accumulator is never passed through touch() -- only A and B reads count toward the miss vector
